semiconductor_relevance: High — DAE YANG HI-TECH is a key distributor and service provider for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and materials.
summary: DAE YANG HI-TECH is a prominent distributor in the Korean semiconductor market, representing MIPOX and SPS-international. The company offers a range of products including polishing films, cleaning sheets, and equipment like filters and spin coaters. They also provide CMP consignment polishing and measurement services for advanced semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Distribution of polishing films and cleaning sheets
Supply of filters and spin coaters
